MONO/LITH.law: One impossible solid in open water or wild land, alone, with weather around it.
MONO/LITH.notes: Built-on pins are lone objects at sea and in forest: floating cube among icebergs, orange square in storm water, lone sailboat, black object hovering over ocean, rock in a room splitting lightning, green pyramid in forest, concrete block with red-lit windows. Weight: horizon + one solid + one tiny human for scale. Less city, more sea, ice and storm.

DREAM/COLLAGE.law: Two scales in one frame, and neither one apologizes.
DREAM/COLLAGE.notes: All 36 kept are built on. The move is a real photo with one wrong-sized guest: goldfish on a car, dinosaur at kite height, astronaut over earth, unicorns in fog, cat on a highway, orca in black and white. Keep it photographic and deadpan, natural daylight or fog, no glow-overload; the joke is the scale, not the effects.

HEAD/OPEN.law: The head is a container. Show what is inside it.
HEAD/OPEN.notes: Built-ons: classical stone/statue heads opened by matter: ice block on top, ocean pouring out, black-and-yellow paint over the face, gold lettering on the face, skull mask on red. Monochrome or one accent color (yellow, red, gold). Statue over living face.

HIDE/SKIN.notes: 13 kept, none built on yet: macro surfaces only, woven wool, butterfly wings, cowhide, bracket fungus, feathers, beetle shell, bark with moss, leaf veins, orange reticulated skin, red coral with pearls. Rule stays: fill the frame with one real grown texture; use as a skin on a monumental object, not as a scene.

SMALL/LIFE.law: The smallest animal, lit like a monument.
SMALL/LIFE.notes: 23 kept, 2 built on (lime caterpillar-creature on black, tiny leafhopper on green). Keeps: clownfish in white anemone, goldfish face, hummingbird iridescence, ladybug on mushroom, fuzzy bee, chrysalis. Macro, shallow depth of field, one saturated creature on a soft field, eye-level, enormous presence.

MATTER/TYPE.law: The letter is made of the thing it says.
MATTER/TYPE.notes: 24 built on, the biggest type move: letters as soft 3D matter: moss/grass letters, cloud letters, glass E filled with water, foamy bubble letters, yarn L, flower-filled glass, inflated pastel letters, liquid chrome. One fat letterform, tactile and wet, bright single-color field. Render the word HALO (or a single letter) as the matter.

BENT/TYPE.law: The word moves the way it means.
BENT/TYPE.notes: All 11 kept are built on: black-on-white kinetic wordmarks: LIQUID melting, TURBULENCE shaking, fall dropping a letter, MILK splashing, LUCID flaming in chrome gradient, BLACK dripping into rainbow, 'feel' smiling. Minimal, one word, one deformation, mostly monochrome with one gradient accent.

SIGN/MARK.notes: Only 3 kept, 2 built: negative-space marks (butterfly made of two faces, ink drop inside the word). Lean on double-reading silhouettes; flat, bold, one color field. Lowest-weight theme.

BITE/COLOR.notes: 18 built on: food as surreal studio product: lollipop heart with ants, watermelon speech bubble, honey-dripping blueberry, waffle with syrup, cards with heart-shaped meat, teacup on a tongue, flower in nose, honey heart with bees, noodle knitting, ice-cream turtle. Clean seamless backdrops (red, pink, cream, yellow), one food object doing something it shouldn't, glossy macro light.

TAPE/DECK.law: The machine that played it, kept as a relic.
TAPE/DECK.notes: 3 built on: a white Panasonic-style cassette recorder, a wall-sized maximal boombox/console, a translucent cassette with exposed reels. Product-photo isolation on plain backdrops plus one monumental machine; show the guts through clear plastic.

TOY/SMILE.law: A small grin with a hard edge.
TOY/SMILE.notes: 21 built on: yellow acid smileys (tennis balls in thorns, biohazard ball pit, skull smiley, yin-yang smiley, smiley crumpled in foil), gummy bear, pixel characters, pill and blister packs, transparent tech toys. Acid-house smiley is the core icon; glossy product render on black.

ACID/GRADIENT.law: Color that glows like a screen, not paint.
ACID/GRADIENT.notes: 15 built on: thermal/chroma gradients on chrome bodies and heads (rainbow-chrome torso, CHROMA glass ribbon, neon cyber-grunge head with lime/orange gear, glowing purple ribbons, blurred glowing cat, stacked glass app-icons). Black or flat-blue fields, iridescent glass/chrome, thermal-camera color.

POSTER/GRID.law: Type, grid, one image, no mercy.
POSTER/GRID.notes: 39 built on, the largest set: neo-brutalist rave posters: acid-lime on black, one chrome/3D hero (crystal cluster, alien flower, alarm clock with goldfish, chrome head, plastic bag, red keyboard key), huge cropped grotesk headlines, grids, barcodes, stickers. For HALO renders: keep the hero object and the lime/black/chrome palette, drop the readable text.

POUR/DRIP.notes: No theme-board marks; 8 POUR/DRIP pins kept and built on from the General Wall: pink slime down black brick, neon green slime over a statue head with lime halo, gold dripping lips, yellow oil cells, glossy chocolate drops, liquid goldfish jelly. Glossy viscous neon on dark stone.

SIGNAL/NOISE.notes: 9 built on: CMYK misregistered dots, test-card circle, glitch chess knight, line-warped sphere, checkerboard beast, pixelated face with yellow code, TV color bars over a face, glowing pixel icons. Black fields, RGB split, color bars, checker, pixel blocks on a real object.
